intrebari.intrebare: The two friends haven't seen each other for months, so they are meeting to ______.
intrebari.explicatie: catch up (with friends) = talk about everything that has happened since you last met. 'Make up' means to become friends again after an argument.

intrebari.intrebare: They are having a ______ chat over coffee and cake.
intrebari.explicatie: A cosy chat is a relaxed, friendly conversation.

intrebari.intrebare: 'You'll never guess what happened!' The woman is about to share a ______ of gossip.
intrebari.explicatie: We say 'a piece of gossip', in the same way as 'a piece of news' or 'a piece of advice'.

intrebari.intrebare: There's a ______ atmosphere in the café: soft lights, quiet music, and nobody is in a hurry.
intrebari.explicatie: A relaxed atmosphere is calm and informal.

intrebari.intrebare: Neither of them had time for lunch, so they decided to ______ a bite at the café.
intrebari.explicatie: grab a bite (to eat) = eat something quickly. It is informal.

intrebari.intrebare: When the woman finished her story, they both ______ laughing.
intrebari.explicatie: burst out laughing = suddenly start laughing. Be careful: 'burst into laughter', but 'burst out laughing'.

intrebari.intrebare: The waiter says 'Here you are!' when he ______.
intrebari.explicatie: 'Here you are' is a fixed phrase we use when we hand something to someone.

intrebari.intrebare: The woman finally told her friend the secret she had been keeping. In other words, she ______.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: spill the beans = reveal a secret. 'Break the ice' means to make people feel relaxed when they first meet.

intrebari.intrebare: The news that his flight was cancelled came as a ______ to the young man.
intrebari.explicatie: come as a shock = be very surprising and upsetting. Look at his face!

intrebari.intrebare: The woman at the check-in desk is ______ a fuss.
intrebari.explicatie: kick up a fuss = complain loudly and angrily.

intrebari.intrebare: She is ______ tired of waiting for hours at the airport.
intrebari.explicatie: Fixed pair: sick and tired of something = very annoyed and bored with it.

intrebari.intrebare: The member of staff behind the desk looks ______.
intrebari.explicatie: -ed adjectives describe how a person feels: she is worried. Something that makes you feel that way is worrying.

intrebari.intrebare: The young man on the chairs is using the delay to catch up on some ______.
intrebari.explicatie: catch up on some sleep = sleep to make up for the sleep you missed.

intrebari.intrebare: The woman ______ a run when she heard the last call.
intrebari.explicatie: break into a run = suddenly start running.

intrebari.intrebare: She reached the gate in the ______ of time.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: in the nick of time = at the very last moment, just before it is too late.

intrebari.intrebare: Her flight leaves at 12:00 and it's 11:59 — she always does everything at the last ______!
intrebari.explicatie: Fixed phrase: at the last minute = as late as possible.

intrebari.intrebare: The student can't remember anything — his mind has gone ______.
intrebari.explicatie: your mind goes blank = you suddenly cannot remember or think of anything.

intrebari.intrebare: He is ______ his brains, trying to remember the answer.
intrebari.explicatie: rack your brains = think very hard to remember something or to solve a problem.

intrebari.intrebare: He is extremely nervous. In fact, he's a ______ of nerves.
intrebari.explicatie: a bundle of nerves = a very nervous person.

intrebari.intrebare: The answer is on the ______ of his tongue, but he just can't remember it.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: on the tip of your tongue = you know it, but you can't remember it at that moment.

intrebari.intrebare: He really should have learned the important dates ______ heart.
intrebari.explicatie: Fixed phrase: learn something by heart = memorise it perfectly.

intrebari.intrebare: Good news! The student has ______ the exam with flying colours.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: pass with flying colours = pass very successfully. 'Past' is not a verb.

intrebari.intrebare: He is thrilled to ______ with his result.
intrebari.explicatie: thrilled to bits = extremely pleased (informal).

intrebari.intrebare: His friend says 'Well done!' to ______ him.
intrebari.explicatie: 'Well done!' is the fixed phrase we use to congratulate someone.

intrebari.intrebare: The friends are going for a ______ walk to get some fresh air and exercise.
intrebari.explicatie: A brisk walk is a quick, energetic walk.

intrebari.intrebare: The view from the hill is ______ — the man can't stop admiring it.
intrebari.explicatie: breathtaking = extremely beautiful. 'Breathless' means out of breath.

intrebari.intrebare: In the distance there is a ______ village with an old church.
intrebari.explicatie: picturesque = pretty, like a picture. A picturesque village is a very common collocation.

intrebari.intrebare: The path follows ______ lanes between the hills.
intrebari.explicatie: winding lanes = narrow roads with many bends. ('Wounding' comes from 'wound', an injury.)

intrebari.intrebare: Suddenly the sky went dark and it started raining cats and ______.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: it's raining cats and dogs = it's raining very heavily.

intrebari.intrebare: The two hikers got caught in ______ rain.
intrebari.explicatie: torrential rain = very heavy rain. We need an adjective before the noun.

intrebari.intrebare: They are completely wet — they are soaked to the ______.
intrebari.explicatie: Fixed phrase: soaked to the skin = completely wet.

intrebari.intrebare: The strong wind has turned the man's umbrella inside ______.
intrebari.explicatie: inside out = with the inside part turned to the outside.

intrebari.intrebare: The dad burnt the food and ______ off the smoke alarm.
intrebari.explicatie: set off a smoke alarm = make it start ringing.

intrebari.intrebare: He wanted to cook everything from ______ instead of buying a ready meal.
intrebari.explicatie: cook from scratch = cook using basic ingredients, not ready-made food.

intrebari.intrebare: The boy is covering his ears because the alarm is so ______.
intrebari.explicatie: After 'is so' we need an adjective: loud.

intrebari.intrebare: Cooking a big dinner with no experience was a ______ for disaster.
intrebari.explicatie: Idiom: a recipe for disaster = something that is very likely to go wrong. Careful: a receipt is the paper you get in a shop!

intrebari.intrebare: This is a ______ family: they are very close and love spending time together.
intrebari.explicatie: close-knit family = a family whose members support each other and are very close.

intrebari.intrebare: Grandma says 'Help ______!' to invite everyone to take some food.
intrebari.explicatie: Fixed phrase: Help yourself / Help yourselves (when you speak to more than one person) = take as much food as you want.

intrebari.intrebare: This weekend they are ______ the grandparents over for dinner.
intrebari.explicatie: have someone over for dinner = invite someone to your home for a meal.

intrebari.intrebare: Everyone is ______ enjoying the meal.
intrebari.explicatie: thoroughly enjoy = enjoy very much. Watch the spelling: t-h-o-r-o-u-g-h-l-y.
